experience.description: My career path as a Web App Developer, dedicated to high-performance applications and clean architecture.

details: Managed and maintained 15+ production websites, primarily WordPress, resolving critical issues across functionality, plugins, email delivery, access, performance, and website availability.
Developed and maintained Nuxt-based company profile website with Decap CMS + GitHub Actions, enabling automated content publishing for articles, brochures, and job vacancies.

Built an automated recruitment workflow and Google Analytics integration, enabling job applications with PDF/CV attachments sent directly to HR email while providing website traffic and user behavior insights.

Resolved critical security and incidents, including WordPress compromises, malicious backdoors, SEO spam, database cleanup, Nginx issues, and SSL renewal—restoring affected services and improving production stability.
Developed practical skills across backend services, frontend interfaces, and deployment.
Developed a simple quiz application for training tasks using React.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Contributed to the development of the Bossman App Dashboard at Soca AI.
Migrated a monolithic service to a microservices architecture to improve scalability and maintainability.
Managed development tasks and collaboration using Trello and Gitlab.
